Neha —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick update from AP: the virtual card authorization attempted on our end returned a decline from our provider (card network flagged as high-risk). We can proceed by wire, but two items before we can release funds:

1) We need your full bank wiring instructions (SWIFT, account, beneficiary address) and an ACH routing token if available.
2) Acme performs VAT withholding on cross-border SaaS purchases unless we have a formal VAT exemption / residency cert on file for the vendor. The attached VAT PDF for Redwood looks abbreviated — can you confirm that it is a valid certificate for 2026 and provide the issuing authority + company registration number?

If wiring, next available pay date from Acme is 10/7 (bank cutoff 10/05 for same-week settlement). If you can provide full wire instructions and the completed tax evidence by end of day 10/04, we can make the 10/7 payment run.

If Redwood can accept a split: we can retry a smaller virtual-card authorization for up to $10k immediately and wire the balance on 10/7. Which do you prefer?

Samantha Lee
